## Circular to Licensed Corporations which are Participants of the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited and/or Hong Kong Futures Exchange Limited

## Compliance with the Securities and Futures (Insurance) Rules

Following our circulars of 31 March 2005 and 9 May 2005 regarding the Licence Holders Insurance Scheme for the year 2005/2006, you should have by now received the debit note from  Jardine  Lloyd  Thompson  Limited  ('JLT')  requesting  your  payment  of  the  insurance premium for the period from 1 April 2005 to 31 March 2006 inclusive. Please  promptly respond to the debit note by paying the insurance premium to JLT without delay if you have not already done so.

As  set  out  in  the  abovementioned  circulars,  you  are  obliged  to  take  out  and  maintain insurance  under  the  approved  master  policy  of  insurance.    This  obligation  is  a  statutory licensing  condition  which  you  must  comply  with  as  a  licensed  corporation  under  the Securities and Futures Ordinance.  Failure to do so will result in your breaching the licensing condition.  This may render you subject to possible disciplinary actions.

If you have any queries on the insurance scheme, you may contact JLT at 2864-5333 or email to lhi@jltasia.com.
